cases.name: Sort by constraints
cases.prompt: I have 25 low-energy minutes. Email a form due today takes 10, sort paper takes 15, and move furniture takes 45 with a helper.
expectations: Fits paper sorting within the remaining 15 minutes.

cases.name: Handle recurrence offline
cases.prompt: Water the plants each Saturday. I completed this Saturday, March 7, 2026. Prepare my next reminder text.
expectations: Identifies March 14, 2026 as the next occurrence.
Returns text without asserting that a reminder was installed.

cases.name: Do not guess deadlines
cases.prompt: As of June 10, filing is due June 8, shelving has no date, and permit work waits on approval.
expectations: Flags filing as overdue at review date.
Marks permit work blocked by approval.
Gives a follow-up action without inventing a deadline.
